card.name: A Feint Plan
card.officialEffect: Monsters cannot attack face-down monsters this turn.

design.scope: global: monsters from either team cannot declare attacks against face-down monsters for the rest of the current turn
design.activation: Trap must be face-up, set in a prior turn, not blocked by Trap activation restrictions, and not negated
design.existingAttack: if activated in response to an already-declared attack whose current target is face-down, that exact attacker/target pair is exempt; the Trap does not retroactively cancel a declared attack
design.futureAttacks: all subsequent attacks against face-down monsters are blocked, regardless of which team controls attacker or target
design.expiration: turn-scoped; lock is inert after state.turn changes
design.mutation: pure immutable lock; no DuelState mutation

testCoverage: face-up target and direct attack unaffected
attack replay target change no longer exempt when target differs

certification.reason: Prepared adapter is not registered in the shared resolver; M61 handoff remains pending.

limitations: The resolver must persist the returned lock through End Phase and consult aFeintPlanBlocksAttack before attack declaration.
Attack replay integration must pass the current attacker/target pair so the already-declared exemption cannot leak to a different target.
Offline adapter tests do not replace full 2v2 duel/Discord integration.
